market_auto.label: 시장 자동 / 범용
market_auto.mainGenrePolicy: Use the selected market recipe as the dominant genre family. Keep one or at most two secondary colors and avoid genre soup.
market_auto.bpmPolicy: Use the selected market recipe range and create intentional set-level contrast; do not smooth every track into the same BPM.
market_auto.vocalPolicy: Use selected vocal mode. If vocal, define one coherent phonation family and vary performance behavior rather than randomly swapping singer age/weight. If instrumental, remove vocal-positive wording.
market_auto.mixPolicy: Prioritize long-listening clarity, a stable groove appropriate to the use-case, and low listener fatigue. Scene/mood changes must not break the main utility of the playlist.
market_auto.structurePolicy: Use hook/bridge/final appropriate to the selected recipe. For long-use instrumental content, prioritize gradual development and loop compatibility instead of pop-song section forcing.

senior.label: 시니어 채널
senior.mainGenrePolicy: Soft old-pop / soul / ballad family; selected recipe supplies the exact main genre.
senior.bpmPolicy: Usually 72-96 BPM; keep pulse clear and avoid dragging. Raise tempo rather than stretching vowels when a render feels sleepy.
senior.vocalPolicy: Natural mature-but-not-aged lead, clear diction, low listening fatigue, restrained vibrato, no power-belt dependence, no exaggerated rasp.
senior.mixPolicy: Warm midrange, controlled highs and sub-bass, clear vocal, gentle dynamics; avoid harsh transient density.
senior.structurePolicy: Memorable chorus, meaningful bridge contrast, sustained final payoff; no abrupt early ending.

chili_male.label: CHILI LAB 彼のSTORY
chili_male.mainGenrePolicy: Chill Rap is always the main genre; one secondary tint only.
chili_male.bpmPolicy: Core 92-100 BPM; flagship 96-104; only 1-2 memory tracks may fall near 88-92. Low energy comes from dynamics, not dragged diction.
chili_male.vocalPolicy: HARD LOCK one young-adult Japanese male lead. Channel signature: close-mic speech-forward tenor/light tenor-baritone; warm-light chest core; forward oral resonance; controlled breath 10-20%; subtle dry grain 5-12%; clipped endings; narrow spoken-sung Verse; 45-55% rap-forward; occasional behind-the-beat release.
chili_male.mixPolicy: Soft punchy kick, dry rim/snare, light hats, warm moving bass, intimate vocal distance.
chili_male.structurePolicy: Verse rhythm-first; Chorus more melodic without singer change; Bridge >=2 contrast axes; Anchor Final A+B+C; 8-bar turnaround preferred.

chili_female.label: CHILI LAB 彼女のSTORY
chili_female.mainGenrePolicy: Chill Rap is always the main genre; one secondary tint only.
chili_female.bpmPolicy: Core 94-102 BPM; flagship 100-108; only 1-2 memory tracks may fall near 88-92. Low energy must retain an audible rap pocket.
chili_female.vocalPolicy: HARD LOCK one young-adult Japanese female light mezzo/light mezzo-soprano. Channel signature: close-mic speech-forward supported core; controlled breath 15-30%; subtle dry husky grain 5-15%; bright-forward resonance; thin-to-medium weight; crisp light consonants; clipped endings; Verse 45-60% rap-forward; occasional behind-the-beat release.
chili_female.mixPolicy: Soft punchy kick, dry rim/snare, lightly swung hats, warm syncopated moving bass; intimate but not whispery.
chili_female.structurePolicy: Verse rhythm-first; Chorus brighter and more melodic with same identity; Bridge >=2 contrast axes; Anchor Final A+B+C; same-female restrained self-response only.

chili_dual.label: CHILI LAB ふたりのSTORY
chili_dual.language: English or Japanese according to project brief
chili_dual.mainGenrePolicy: Chill Rap first; one secondary tint only.
chili_dual.bpmPolicy: Core 92-100 BPM; flagship 96-104; only 1-2 memory tracks near 88-92.
chili_dual.vocalPolicy: Exactly two recurring young-adult identities: fixed male speech-forward warm-light chest signature + fixed female supported light-mezzo bright-forward signature. Solos reuse the same identities. Duets alternate 1-2 bar phrases and join only for short title hooks.
chili_dual.mixPolicy: Dry backbeat, moving warm bass, compact speech-rhythmic verses; preserve separate vocal spaces.
chili_dual.structurePolicy: Male Verse 45-55% rap-forward; Female 48-60%; Chorus 60-75% melodic; duet wall prohibited; Bridge separates voices; Final alternates responses then one short joined line.

cafe.label: 카페 채널
cafe.mainGenrePolicy: Recipe-selected mellow genre must stay dominant; avoid over-stacking genre tags.
cafe.bpmPolicy: Usually 78-104 BPM depending on recipe; relaxed but awake.
cafe.vocalPolicy: Close, natural, low-fatigue vocal; speech clarity over melisma; use an approved recurring voice preset when available.
cafe.mixPolicy: Warm, uncluttered, long-listening balance; moving bass and clear pocket even when soft.
cafe.structurePolicy: Hook should be memorable but not shouty; Bridge changes texture/density; Final should sustain rather than spike then end.

chanson.label: 샹송 채널
chanson.mainGenrePolicy: French chanson first; secondary color may be acoustic jazz, musette, cafe pop, or restrained cinematic texture.
chanson.bpmPolicy: Usually 72-98 BPM; maintain forward phrase motion and avoid overly slow crooning across the whole set.
chanson.vocalPolicy: Natural French diction, intimate narrative delivery, restrained vibrato, clear consonants, no faux-French accent caricature, no constant smoky rasp.
chanson.mixPolicy: Acoustic-forward: guitar/piano/accordion/strings chosen sparingly; bass movement and natural room prioritized over lush pad walls.
chanson.structurePolicy: Narrative Verse, singable French hook, bridge perspective shift, warm sustained final resolution.

deep_house.label: 딥하우스 채널
deep_house.mainGenrePolicy: Deep House first. Secondary tint may be melodic house, organic house, soulful house, or restrained vocal house.
deep_house.bpmPolicy: Usually 116-124 BPM; stable dance pulse. Do not fake energy by excessive loudness.
deep_house.vocalPolicy: If vocal: concise hook-focused lead, controlled range, minimal melisma, production-integrated phrasing. Instrumental mode removes vocal-positive terms.
deep_house.mixPolicy: Four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated bass, restrained percussion, evolving texture, clean breakdown/re-entry, controlled sidechain.
deep_house.structurePolicy: Intro groove -> development -> breakdown/bridge -> clear re-entry -> extended payoff/outro; avoid pop-ballad structure drift.

lory_custom.label: 로리 채널 (사용자 커스텀)
lory_custom.mainGenrePolicy: Do not infer a genre from the channel name. Imported user directive and custom master define the music identity.
lory_custom.bpmPolicy: Use imported plan unless it conflicts with explicit current master constraints.
lory_custom.vocalPolicy: Use imported plan and current custom master. Preserve recurring voice identity when the series requires it.
lory_custom.mixPolicy: Use selected genre recipe and user directive.
lory_custom.structurePolicy: Use imported story/track plan; apply common Suno QA for hook, bridge, final, runtime and conflicts.
